blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25534825 and Fluent block 10309817, the EIP-1967 implementation slots resolve to the independently verified JMIExtension implementations 0x1028a0e146d2915c509c8e019e0e5c66d3d22ae0 and 0x18091d82d55f68205f7f829acadb7897a7cb7d9c. Both verified implementations expose FREEZE_MANAGER_ROLE, freeze(address), freezeAccounts(address[]), unfreeze, unfreezeAccounts, and pause controls. Role-event histories show FREEZE_MANAGER_ROLE was transferred from the deployment account to 0x169A3703D64a100897C0E208a3Dcad86F3F6eC29; pinned hasRole reads for that account return true on both deployments. Therefore an active privileged authority can directly freeze arbitrary holder accounts across every tracked USDnr deployment.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: USDNR is an M0 extension on Ethereum backed by the M0 MinterGateway rail (mint-authority review 2026-06-11); the token proxy's EIP-1967 admin is Nerona's ProxyAdmin 0x9ffe615c92635e5b36de004dd78a94c51aa04256 (owner EOA 0xc07f0b4556e0cc1bfd8a076a98d43e79acd3cd33, read 2026-07-20).

Issuer-native deployment: the Fluent USDNR token is the same-style transparent proxy with the identical EIP-1967 admin 0x9ffe615c92635e5b36de004dd78a94c51aa04256 (owner EOA 0xc07f0b4556e0cc1bfd8a076a98d43e79acd3cd33) as the canonical Ethereum deployment (read 2026-07-20) — Nerona/M0 administers the deployment directly; no third-party bridge contract sits in the mint path. The Fluent Foundation's BLEND token-sale disclosure (April 2026) confirms USDnr is an M0-platform extension legally issued by MXON as Minter, with Fluent as an official M0 spoke chain.
